spanish: a tierra manante leche y miel, porque no subiré en medio de ti, porque pueblo duro de nuca tú, no sea que te consuma en el camino.

findings.issue: Piel imperfect 1cs with a 2ms suffix licenses the speaker as the one who consumes you. te consuma matches the object and the transitive end-force, but the subjunctive form is also 3rd person when yo is absent.

notes: The other tokens match, including the verbless pueblo duro de nuca tú without an unmarked copula.
